stem.text: Which statements about the Michaelis–Menten constant ($K_\text{m}$) are correct?

items: The higher the $K_\text{m}$, the higher the enzyme affinity for the substrate.
$K_\text{m}$ is a measure of the degree of enzyme affinity for the substrate.
$K_\text{m}$ is defined as the substrate concentration at which the enzyme functions at half its maximum rate.
